is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae (s.s.) and Anopheles arabiensis.

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper reports genotyping for Vgsc-995S/F (kdr), Cyp6aa1, Cyp6p4-I236M, ZZB-TE, Cyp4j5-L43F, and Coeae1d.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Tables 4 and 5 provide genotype counts (resistant alleles n/N) for various markers in An. gambiae (s.s.) populations.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected from 11 districts in Uganda.

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical study involving field collection and laboratory analysis of mosquitoes.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study specifies 11 districts in Uganda (Mubende, Kayunga, Kole, Otuke, Dokolo, Amolatar, Amuru, Lamwo, Agago, Busia, Tororo).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Larvae were collected between May 2018 and December 2020.

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes new collections and analyses for this specific project.

supplement.evidence: The necessary genotype data is provided in the main text tables (Tables 4 and 5).

assessment.summary: This study characterized pyrethroid resistance in Anopheles gambiae (s.s.) and Anopheles arabiensis from 11 districts in Uganda with varying vector control histories. It found high levels of pyrethroid resistance and widespread presence of resistance markers, with significant associations between certain markers and phenotypic survival.
